title: TWA release artifacts + Play Store submission readiness (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Add a publicly accessible Privacy Policy page with English placeholder content and link it from a persistent UI location.
acceptanceCriteria: A Privacy Policy page is accessible via a stable URL path/route in the deployed app.
The footer (or another persistent navigation area) includes a “Privacy Policy” link that opens the page.
All page text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated Privacy Policy page with clear English content suitable as placeholder legal text for Play Store submission.
Wire the new Privacy Policy page into the existing hash-route switch (e.g., route key like "privacy-policy") so it is reachable at a stable URL.
Add a persistent “Privacy Policy” link that navigates to the Privacy Policy hash-route.

requirements.summary: Keep Digital Asset Links file deployable and add explicit in-repo instructions for replacing package name and SHA-256 fingerprint placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` is present under `frontend/public/.well-known/` and is included in the built/deployed static assets.
Documentation clearly instructs replacing `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT` with real values after signing key generation.
A developer can open `{origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json` in the browser and see valid JSON (after replacing placeholders).

file_operations.description: Confirm the file remains valid JSON and retains the two explicit placeholders `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT` for the TWA verification flow.

Update documentation to explicitly and unambiguously instruct developers to replace exactly two values in `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`: `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT`, and to verify the deployed URL `{origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json` in a browser.

requirements.summary: Ensure PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md and the in-app Play Store publishing section match actual repo URLs and asset filenames/paths.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md` references the correct current paths used in the repo (e.g., `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, `/manifest.webmanifest`).
The in-app Play Store publishing section shows correct URLs based on `window.location.origin` and matches the guide’s described URLs.
Referenced asset filenames match the repo’s static assets under `frontend/public/` (including `/assets/generated/...`).

file_operations.description: Audit and update the guide so all referenced URLs/paths are correct and consistent with the repo: manifest URL `{origin}/manifest.webmanifest`, asset links URL `{origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, Privacy Policy URL (the new stable route), icon filenames under `frontend/public/assets/generated/`, and feature graphic path `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png`.

Update the in-app “Publish to Google Play Store” section to (1) reflect the correct manifest and assetlinks URLs derived from `window.location.origin`, (2) include the Privacy Policy URL for the new page route, and (3) reference the exact static asset filenames/paths under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` including `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png`, `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png`, and `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add the required Play Store Android phone screenshot asset as a static file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png` so docs/UI references are valid.

Add the required Play Store Android phone screenshot asset as a static file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png` so docs/UI references are valid.

requirements.summary: Harden the Bubblewrap release helper script output clarity and alignment with the repo’s assetlinks/docs workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `frontend/scripts/twa/bubblewrap-release.sh` completes without ambiguous output paths and clearly indicates where the generated `.apk` and `.aab` artifacts are located.
The script prints the computed SHA-256 fingerprint and reiterates the exact placeholders to replace in `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`.
The script’s documented next steps align with `frontend/public/.well-known/ASSETLINKS_SETUP.md` and `frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md`.

file_operations.description: Improve script robustness and clarity by ensuring printed artifact paths are unambiguous (absolute paths), validating that the expected `.aab` and `.apk` files exist before printing success, and ensuring the “Next Steps” text precisely matches the placeholders `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT` as documented in `frontend/public/.well-known/ASSETLINKS_SETUP.md` and `frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md`.

Ensure the TWA scripts README stays consistent with the hardened `bubblewrap-release.sh` workflow, including where outputs are written, and the required follow-up of updating `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and redeploying the frontend.

requirements.summary: Add a Play Store pre-submission checklist that is explicit and usable without external context.
acceptanceCriteria: A checklist exists (in docs and/or the existing Play Store publishing UI section) that includes: manifest URL, assetlinks URL, privacy policy URL, and required Play Store visual assets.
Checklist text is in English and is specific enough to follow without external context.

file_operations.description: Expand/verify the “Pre-Submission Checklist” section so it explicitly lists and explains what must be ready before uploading the AAB: manifest URL, assetlinks URL, privacy policy URL (new route), and required visuals including `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png`, `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png`, and `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png`.

Add (or update) an in-app pre-submission checklist subsection that mirrors `frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md` and includes explicit, copyable URLs based on `window.location.origin` for: manifest, assetlinks, and privacy policy, plus a list of required visual asset filenames/paths. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
